headlines.title: China's National Bureau of Statistics said nationwide consumer prices (CPI) rose 0.5% YoY
headlines.summary: China's National Bureau of Statistics said nationwide consumer prices (CPI) rose 0.5% YoY in July 2026 and fell 0.1% MoM.
headlines.title_zh: 中国国家统计局称全国居民消费价格（CPI）同比上涨0.5%
headlines.summary_zh: 中国国家统计局称，2026年7月全国居民消费价格（CPI）同比上涨0.5%，环比下降0.1%。

headlines.title: 国家统计局：7月份，核心CPI环比上涨0.3%，同比上涨0.9%
headlines.summary: 金十数据8月9日讯，国家统计局城市司首席统计师董莉娟：7月份，受国际输入性因素影响，居民消费价格指数（CPI）环比下降0.1%，同比上涨0.5%，扣除食品和能源价格的核心CPI环比上涨0.3%，同比上涨0.9%，CPI总体保持温和上涨。国内部分行业需求增加，但受输入性和季节性等因素影响，工业生产者出厂价格指数（PPI）环比下降0.7%，同比上涨3.5%，涨幅比上月回落0.6个百分点。

headlines.title_en: NBS: In July, core CPI rose 0.3% month-on-month and 0.9% year-on-year
headlines.summary_en: Jin Shi Data August 9 - Dong Lijuan, Chief Statistician of the Urban Department of the National Bureau of Statistics: In July, affected by international input factors, the Consumer Price Index (CPI) fell 0.1% month-on-month and rose 0.5% year-on-year. The core CPI, excluding food and energy prices, rose 0.3% month-on-month and 0.9% year-on-year, with CPI maintaining a moderate overall increase. Demand in some domestic industries increased, but due to input and seasonal factors, the Producer Price Index (PPI) fell 0.7% month-on-month and rose 3.5% year-on-year, with the increase narrowing by 0.6 percentage points from the previous month.

headlines.title_en: NBS: In July, the year-on-year increase in PPI moderated
headlines.summary_en: Jin Shi Data August 9 - Dong Lijuan, Chief Statistician of the Urban Department of the National Bureau of Statistics: Year-on-year, national PPI rose 3.5%, with the increase narrowing by 0.6 percentage points from the previous month. By industry, among the main industries with rising prices, oil and natural gas extraction, petroleum, coal and other fuel processing, and chemical raw materials and chemical products manufacturing rose 3.2%, 8.2%, and 9.1% respectively; non-ferrous metal mining and dressing, and non-ferrous metal smelting and rolling processing rose 22.6% and 20.2% respectively; ferrous metal smelting and rolling processing rose 2.7%, with increases all narrowing from the previous month. These six industries collectively contributed approximately 2.55 percentage points to the year-on-year PPI increase. Coal mining and washing rose 27.1%, electrical machinery and equipment manufacturing rose 5.7%, and computer, communication and other electronic equipment manufacturing rose 4.4%, with increases all narrowing from the previous month.

headlines.title: 中国7月CPI同比增长0.5%，前值增长1%
headlines.summary: 2026年7月份，全国居民消费价格同比上涨0.5%。其中，城市上涨0.5%，农村上涨0.4%；食品价格下降1.5%，非食品价格上涨0.9%；消费品价格上涨0.2%，服务价格上涨0.7%。1­­—7月平均，全国居民消费价格比上年同期上涨0.9%。

headlines.title_en: China July CPI rises 0.5% year-on-year, previous value up 1%
headlines.summary_en: In July 2026, the national consumer prices rose 0.5% year-on-year. Among them, urban areas rose 0.5% and rural areas rose 0.4%; food prices fell 1.5%, while non-food prices rose 0.9%; consumer goods prices rose 0.2% and service prices rose 0.7%. On average from January to July, national consumer prices rose 0.9% compared to the same period last year.

headlines.title: 中国7月PPI同比增长3.5%，前值增长4.1%
headlines.summary: 2026年7月份，全国工业生产者出厂价格同比上涨3.5%，环比下降0.7%。工业生产者购进价格同比上涨5.5%，环比下降1.0%。1—7月平均，工业生产者出厂价格比上年同期上涨1.8%，工业生产者购进价格上涨2.8%。

headlines.title_en: China July PPI rises 3.5% year-on-year, previous value up 4.1%
headlines.summary_en: In July 2026, the national Producer Price Index rose 3.5% year-on-year and fell 0.7% month-on-month. The purchasing price index for industrial producers rose 5.5% year-on-year and fell 1.0% month-on-month. On average from January to July, the Producer Price Index rose 1.8% compared to the same period last year, and the purchasing price index for industrial producers rose 2.8%.

headlines.title_zh: 国家统计局：7月PPI环比下降0.7%
headlines.summary_zh: 国家统计局城市统计司司长董丽娟表示，7月工业生产者出厂价格指数环比下降0.7%，降幅比6月扩大0.4个百分点。输入性因素导致的价格下降是主要拖累：石油开采业下降11.8%，石油煤炭加工业下降8.4%，有机化学原料制造业下降7.2%。

headlines.title_en: NBS: In July, CPI rose moderately year-on-year, with gold jewelry prices up 24.6%
headlines.summary_en: Jin Shi Data August 9 - Dong Lijuan, Chief Statistician of the Urban Department of the National Bureau of Statistics: Year-on-year, national CPI rose 0.5%, maintaining a moderate increase. The year-on-year CPI increase narrowed by 0.5 percentage points from the previous month, mainly due to a narrower increase in gasoline prices. Gasoline prices rose 1.0%, with the increase narrowing by 16.0 percentage points from the previous month, reducing the upward contribution to CPI by approximately 0.45 percentage points compared to the previous month, and driving the energy price increase to narrow to 0.6%. Industrial consumer goods excluding energy rose 1.5%, with the increase narrowing by 0.2 percentage points from the previous month, contributing approximately 0.37 percentage points to the year-on-year CPI increase. Among them, gold jewelry, personal care products, and household appliances prices rose 24.6%, 1.7%, and 0.2% respectively, with increases all narrowing, collectively contributing approximately 0.13 percentage points to the year-on-year CPI increase.

headlines.title_en: NBS: In July, PPI fell month-on-month
headlines.summary_en: Jin Shi Data August 9 - Dong Lijuan, Chief Statistician of the Urban Department of the National Bureau of Statistics: Month-on-month, national PPI fell 0.7%, with the decline widening by 0.4 percentage points from the previous month. The main characteristics of this month's PPI month-on-month movements: First, input factors affected price declines in related domestic industries. Oil extraction, refined petroleum product manufacturing, and organic chemical raw material manufacturing prices fell 11.8%, 8.4%, and 4.2% respectively; non-ferrous metal mining and dressing, and non-ferrous metal smelting and rolling processing prices fell 2.1% and 1.7% respectively. These five industries collectively contributed approximately 0.65 percentage points to the month-on-month PPI decline. Second, seasonal factors affected price declines in some industries. headlines.title: China’s factory-gate prices growth slows to 3.5% in July amid lower fuel prices
headlines.summary:
China’s factory-gate prices growth slowed in July, as lower domestic fuel prices eased cost pressures triggered by the US-Israel war on Iran, while high temperatures dragged manufacturing.
The producer price index (PPI) rose by 3.5 per cent year on year last month, compared with 4.1 per cent in June, according to data released by the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) on Sunday.

headlines.summary_en: Jin Shi Data August 9 - Dong Lijuan, Chief Statistician of the Urban Department of the National Bureau of Statistics: Month-on-month, national CPI fell 0.1%, with the decline narrowing by 0.2 percentage points from the previous month. headlines.title_en: NBS: In July, month-on-month changes in prices of various goods and services
headlines.summary_en: Jin Shi Data August 9 - National Bureau of Statistics: In July, prices for food, tobacco, alcohol, and dining-out were flat month-on-month. Among food, meat prices rose 1.9%, contributing approximately 0.07 percentage points to the CPI increase, with pork prices up 4.1%; fresh vegetable prices rose 1.3%, contributing approximately 0.02 percentage points to the CPI increase; fresh fruit prices fell 3.8%, contributing approximately -0.07 percentage points to the CPI decline; egg prices fell 1.7%, contributing approximately -0.01 percentage points to the CPI decline. Among the other seven major categories, prices rose in three, were flat in two, and fell in two month-on-month. Among them, education, culture and entertainment, medical care, and household goods and services prices rose 1.0%, 0.8%, and 0.4% respectively; housing and other goods and services prices were flat; transport and communication and clothing prices fell 2.2% and 0.4% respectively.
